name: Anchorage + Fairbanks, Alaska
tagline: Northern lights, hot springs, deep snow
whyParents: Bucket-list aurora and a steaming outdoor hot spring, no passport and no jet lag.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate: PHL-ANC in, FAI-PHL out (1 stop, Alaska/AA via SEA or DFW) ~$650 plus ANC-FAI hop ~$150. Kayak says December PHL-FAI averages ~$851 RT. No Dec 2026 fare seen.
costPP.lodgingBasis: 3BR home ~$270/night total, 6 nights, split 4 ways (estimate, 3 nights each city)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$70/day food plus Chena aurora tour ~$215 to $235 and AWD SUV share

flight.routing: PHL-DFW-ANC or PHL-SEA-ANC (1 stop); home FAI-SEA-PHL. No AA PHL-ANC nonstop found for Dec 2026.
flight.notes: Alaska Airlines (oneworld, earns AA miles) likely best via SEA. Short ANC-FAI hop ~1h on Alaska Airlines.

weather.precip: Dry cold, light snow; Anchorage milder (~24F/13F)

stay: Downtown Anchorage, then Fairbanks near Chena River: walkable, tour pickups
getAround: Rent AWD midsize SUV (4 adults + bags), studded tires standard. Fly ANC-FAI rather than 6h winter drive.
entry: US domestic: REAL ID or passport only.
events: Aurora Winter Train runs weekends only: northbound Sat 8:30am Anchorage, southbound Sun 8:30am Fairbanks (season Sept 2026 to May 9 2027). Sat Dec 12 is arrival day, so it does not fit this week.
Midweek Aurora Winter Train trips only Feb to March, not December
Aurora season: long dark nights in mid-December, sightings weather dependent
pros: Best aurora odds in the US
Chena outdoor hot springs in snow
No passport, AA miles via Alaska Airlines

name: St. Thomas + St. John, US Virgin Islands
tagline: Turquoise bays, national park, no passport
whyParents: World-class beaches and easy snorkeling in a US territory, with a nonstop from Philly.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate: AA PHL-STT nonstop. AA route page shows RT from ~$586 for spring 2026 dates; December peak likely higher. No Dec 2026 fare seen.
costPP.lodgingBasis: 2 to 3BR villa ~$450/night total, 6 nights (3 St. Thomas, 3 St. John), split 4 ways (estimate)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$90/day food (islands are pricey) plus ferries and Jeep share

flight.routing: PHL-STT nonstop (AA, only nonstop carrier; frequency daily vs few weekly unclear)
flight.notes: Backup: JFK-STT nonstop (AA and Delta listed), or via MIA/CLT on AA.

weather.precip: Brief showers some days, sunny dry season start

stay: Red Hook, St. Thomas, then Cruz Bay, St. John: ferries, beaches, dining
getAround: Rent a Jeep or small SUV for 4 (drive on LEFT). Passenger ferry Red Hook to Cruz Bay ~20 min; car barge also runs.
entry: US territory: no passport for US citizens; bring REAL ID. US customs check when flying home.
pros: Two-thirds of St. John is national park

events: El Yunque PR-191 corridor: free, no reservations required (USFS page updated Feb 27 2026)

name: Quebec City + Montreal, Canada
tagline: French Christmas markets, snowy old towns
whyParents: Feels like a snowy French village at Christmas, with a short flight and scenic train.

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate: PHL-YUL RT ~$350 to $400 in mid-December; no Dec 2026 fare seen.
costPP.lodgingBasis: 2BR apartment ~$250/night total, 6 nights (4 Quebec City, 2 Montreal), split 4 ways (estimate)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$60/day food plus VIA Rail (~$33 to $51 Escape fare each way) and museums

flight.routing: PHL-YUL nonstop (AA/regional) if running Dec 2026; otherwise via CLT or JFK
flight.notes: Air Canada (Aeroplan, Capital One transfer partner) also flies PHL/EWR-YUL.

stay: Old Quebec inside walls, then Old Montreal: walkable, markets, charm
getAround: No car needed. VIA Rail Montreal to Quebec ~3h 17m average; walk, taxis, Montreal Metro.
entry: Valid US passport required. No eTA for US citizens (per secondary sources; check canada.ca).
events: German Christmas Market, Quebec City: Nov 19 to Dec 23 2026, Thu to Sun (plus Dec 21 to 23), free, 5 sites (Bonjour Québec marks dates to be confirmed)
Grand Marché de Noël, Montreal Place des Festivals: ~Nov 13 2026 to Jan 3 2027, daily 11am to 10pm from Dec 9 (start date varies by source)
Village de Noël, Atwater Market Montreal: Nov 26 to Dec 24 2026, free
pros: Both Christmas markets open that week
cons: Quebec market closed Mon to Wed
